entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker and guardian of Zendikar who commands the elementals, takes the Lithoform Core and uses it to heal the plane.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: An ancient kor planeswalker and guardian of Zendikar who fights Nissa's elementals and fails to keep the Core.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage who takes control of Nahiri's mind to steal the Core, then tries to control Nissa, and ends up apologizing.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker and Nahiri's old mentor and sworn enemy, whose appearance in the fortress is a Jace illusion.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A dead Gatewatch planeswalker whom Nissa mourns.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker whose love Nissa has lost.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: A giant four-armed elemental of roots and green buds who pins Jace and delivers the Core to Nissa.

entities.name: Kazandu elementals
entities.description: Dozens of elementals of the Kazandu forest of many forms who fight for Nissa and are revived by the Core.

entities.name: Jaddi eagle elemental
entities.description: A massive eagle elemental of jaddi roots that attacks Nahiri.

entities.name: Fern Elemental
entities.description: The fern elemental Nahiri killed in the Akoum Skyclave.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The titanic beings whose war scarred Zendikar.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan whose battle left the diseased wastes.

entities.name: Singing City
entities.description: The ruined kor city where the confrontation occurs, flattened by the Core's blast.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: The region blooming again after the blast, where Nissa heads.

entities.name: Akoum Skyclave
entities.description: The Skyclave where Nahiri killed the fern elemental.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The silver prison on which Nahiri was once trapped.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane Jace wants to take the Core to.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane Nahiri and Nissa both guard, whose voice speaks through the Core.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: An ancient piece of Zendikar made to undo damage, which heals the plane when Nissa unleashes it.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: The stone constructs Nahiri made, which she summons as weapons.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group Nissa left.

events.summary: Nissa, backed by Kazandu elementals, confronts Jace and Nahiri and orders the elementals to defend Zendikar.
events.quote: Defend Zendikar," she said to the elementals

events.summary: Nahiri battles the elementals but is overwhelmed, her swords brushed aside, and retreats into the Singing City.
events.quote: She didn't stop until she reached the massive marble gates of the Singing City and pushed through them.

events.summary: Jace slips into the city as Nahiri walls off the entrance with stone.
events.quote: a massive wall of stone crushing the marble gates of the city

events.summary: Nahiri builds a fortress; Jace pleads to go to Ravnica but she traps him in a ring of hedrons.
events.quote: trapping Jace within the dangerous ring

events.summary: Nahiri sees Sorin and attacks, but it is a Jace illusion, and Jace seizes control of her mind.
events.quote: Suddenly, her thoughts were not her own.

events.summary: Jace takes the Lithoform Core from Nahiri's satchel and resists its temptation.
Jace escapes the city with the Core, but Ashaya pins him and tosses the Core to Nissa.
Nissa speaks mind-to-mind with Jace while the Core's voice, which is Zendikar itself, speaks to her.
events.quote: I am me. I am you.

events.summary: Nissa realizes Jace is trying to take control of her mind, snaps the link and has Ashaya hold him down.
events.quote: Jace was trying to take control of her mind.

events.summary: Nissa tells Nahiri that Nahiri is what Zendikar once was and Nissa is what it is now.
events.quote: You are what Zendikar once was, Nahiri. I am what it is now.

events.summary: Nissa merges her magic with the Core, colliding with Nahiri's hedrons and flattening the Singing City.
events.quote: Nissa's magic merged with the Core's power.

events.summary: The Core's power heals Zendikar, reviving the elementals and making the Eldrazi wastes bloom.
events.quote: Zendikar was healing, turning into something healthier, stronger than it was before the battle with the Eldrazi.

events.summary: Nissa races to Bala Ged along the leylines, finally home.
Nahiri berates Jace and planeswalks away; Jace resolves to apologize to Nissa.
events.quote: He didn't try to argue as the ancient kor turned and planeswalked away.

relations.note: The elementals defend and follow Nissa.
relations.quote: ready to defend her with their lives

relations.note: They battle over the Core and the fate of Zendikar.
relations.quote: Gritting her teeth, Nissa thrust out her hands and sent a wave of green energy straight at Nahiri.

relations.note: Sorin is her old mentor and sworn enemy.
relations.quote: Nahiri turned and was faced with her old mentor. Her sworn enemy. Sorin.
was faced with her old mentor

relations.note: Ashaya follows her commands, restraining Jace.
relations.quote: silently asked Ashaya to make sure Jace couldn't move

relations.note: Jace takes control of Nahiri's mind to steal the Core.
relations.quote: He could feel Nahiri's mind struggle against his control.

relations.note: The Core speaks with Zendikar's voice and was made to undo damage.
